description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

textBooks.tpb_book_en: Jennifer Carlson, Smart Choice 5 (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 2021). ISBN: 978-0-19-406159-9

readings.tpc_book: 任何能幫助學生增進英文能力的英文閱讀資源皆可

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Final Exam: 20%. Online. Based on Units 1-3 in the textbook.
In-class Writing Assignment: 10%. For this assignment, you'll be given three questions based on the units covered in the textbook and will choose which one to answer.
Final Presentation: 20%. The Final Presentation is to be submitted to the Upload Folder on iLearn. It must be uploaded in the following format for grading.

Attendance, in-class performance, homework: 30%. This includes attendance and participation in class and homework assignments saved into the Upload folder. -2% per class hour missed. -3% per assignment missed. All homework assignments to be uploaded to the appropriate subfolder within the Upload folder on iLearn.

Extensive Reading Using Xreading: 20%. 

*Payment of NT$400 for retakers and transfer students ONLY. Buy with the textbook. You’ll need to take your ID card to make the purchase. You can’t buy for someone else. 

You are required to read 100,000 words per semester. 

Grading policy: you are required to finish 50,000 words before midnight on 12th April to receive 10% of the total 20%; you then have to finish another 50,000 between 13th April and 3rd June to receive the other 10%. 

If you fail to reach the required words before the midterm exam, you cannot make it up afterwards. 

For every 10,000 words more than 100,000, you’ll receive 1% extra up to 5% maximum. 

You must read at least 90% of a book to take a quiz. 15 minutes for a quiz. 60% as minimum score. Any problems, take a screenshot as evidence. Make sure you take quizzes somewhere with reliable internet. 

Rules: 
(1). Students who are caught cheating ONCE will lose the word count earned from the reader that the student was reading. The course instructor will address the offenders individually.
一旦學生被發現作弊，當次所閱讀讀的字數將不列入記錄。授課教師也會親自和該學生進行會談。    


(2). For students caught cheating the SECOND time, they will also lose 20% of their GE grade - in other words - get a zero for xReading.
若學生被發現第2次作弊，該學期廣泛閱讀的成績將以0分計算，該項成績佔總成績

    If you find that you have difficulties during the semester, such as failing to keep up with the learning progress, not understanding, or having problems with homework, please contact the teacher as soon as possible to help you find a solution.

    •  When I find that your learning progress cannot keep up and may hinder your academic success, I may send an early warning message to you and your study tutor. If you receive an early warning notice, it is your responsibility to contact me as soon as possible to discuss learning problems, and I will give you possible assistance through consultation.
    • On the other hand, you can also contact and consult with your study tutor more often, have an interview with you, find your learning obstacles together, and give suggestions to improve your learning.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。

  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。

3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。

  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。

以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
**Academic Integrity and Zero Tolerance for Cheating Policy**
In this course, we uphold a strong commitment to academic integrity, and it is essential that all students adhere to the highest standards of honesty in their academic work. To foster a culture of trust and integrity, we will clearly communicate what is expected of each student, maintain open dialogue, and provide multiple opportunities for you to demonstrate your learning. Violations of this policy, including cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration, will not be tolerated and will result in disciplinary actions.
**Expectations for Academic Conduct:**
1. **Clear Communication of Expectations:** Throughout the course, I will provide clear guidelines on academic conduct, the nature of assignments, and what forms of assistance or collaboration are permissible. It is your responsibility to ask for clarification if you are unsure of the expectations for any assignment.
  
2. **Evaluation Methods to Deter Cheating:**
   - Assignments will be designed to assess your ability to think critically and apply course concepts in authentic ways, such as using real-world data, personal reflections, or multi-stage assessments (e.g., written and oral components).
   - Tasks requiring higher-order thinking will be used to make cheating more difficult and to ensure the work submitted is a genuine reflection of your understanding.
   - Multivariate assessments and decentralized grading weights will be used to reduce the temptation and opportunity to cheat.
3. **Collaboration and Outside Assistance:**
   - For each graded assignment, you will be informed about what forms of collaboration or assistance, if any, are permitted. Unauthorized collaboration or receiving unapproved assistance will be considered cheating.
   - If collaboration is allowed, you must clearly acknowledge the nature of your collaboration or any assistance received when submitting assignments.
4. **Use of Resources:**
   - While using authorized materials (textbooks, software, etc.) is encouraged, it is critical that you follow any specific guidelines provided for each assignment. Unauthorized use of resources, including external websites or tools, without permission constitutes academic dishonesty.
5. **Plagiarism Policy:**
   - All written work will be subjected to plagiarism detection tools (such as Turnitin). Any instances of plagiarism, including copying from others or failure to properly cite sources, will result in penalties.
   - A strict policy on plagiarism ratios will be in place, and students are expected to submit original work that reflects their own thinking and analysis.
**Consequences of Violations:**
Any violations of this academic integrity policy, including cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration, will result in immediate disciplinary action. This may include a failing grade for the assignment or the course, reporting to university authorities, and further academic penalties as deemed appropriate.
By fostering open communication and creating assessments that emphasize learning, we aim to build a classroom environment rooted in trust and academic honesty. If you have any questions or uncertainties, it is your responsibility to seek clarification in advance.

integrity.ais_meno_en:
**Academic Integrity and Zero Tolerance for Cheating Policy**
In this course, we uphold a strong commitment to academic integrity, and it is essential that all students adhere to the highest standards of honesty in their academic work. To foster a culture of trust and integrity, we will clearly communicate what is expected of each student, maintain open dialogue, and provide multiple opportunities for you to demonstrate your learning. Violations of this policy, including cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration, will not be tolerated and will result in disciplinary actions.
**Expectations for Academic Conduct:**
1. **Clear Communication of Expectations:** Throughout the course, I will provide clear guidelines on academic conduct, the nature of assignments, and what forms of assistance or collaboration are permissible. It is your responsibility to ask for clarification if you are unsure of the expectations for any assignment.
  
2. **Evaluation Methods to Deter Cheating:**
   - Assignments will be designed to assess your ability to think critically and apply course concepts in authentic ways, such as using real-world data, personal reflections, or multi-stage assessments (e.g., written and oral components).
   - Tasks requiring higher-order thinking will be used to make cheating more difficult and to ensure the work submitted is a genuine reflection of your understanding.
   - Multivariate assessments and decentralized grading weights will be used to reduce the temptation and opportunity to cheat.
3. **Collaboration and Outside Assistance:**
   - For each graded assignment, you will be informed about what forms of collaboration or assistance, if any, are permitted. Unauthorized collaboration or receiving unapproved assistance will be considered cheating.
   - If collaboration is allowed, you must clearly acknowledge the nature of your collaboration or any assistance received when submitting assignments.
4. **Use of Resources:**
   - While using authorized materials (textbooks, software, etc.) is encouraged, it is critical that you follow any specific guidelines provided for each assignment. Unauthorized use of resources, including external websites or tools, without permission constitutes academic dishonesty.
5. **Plagiarism Policy:**
   - All written work will be subjected to plagiarism detection tools (such as Turnitin). Any instances of plagiarism, including copying from others or failure to properly cite sources, will result in penalties.
   - A strict policy on plagiarism ratios will be in place, and students are expected to submit original work that reflects their own thinking and analysis.
**Consequences of Violations:**
Any violations of this academic integrity policy, including cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration, will result in immediate disciplinary action. This may include a failing grade for the assignment or the course, reporting to university authorities, and further academic penalties as deemed appropriate.
By fostering open communication and creating assessments that emphasize learning, we aim to build a classroom environment rooted in trust and academic honesty. If you have any questions or uncertainties, it is your responsibility to seek clarification in advance.

    Grade scoring for this subject

    • Participate in all classroom activities.

    If you find that you have difficulties during the semester, such as failing to keep up with the learning progress, not understanding, or having problems with homework, please contact the teacher as soon as possible to help you find a solution.

    •  When I find that your learning progress cannot keep up and may hinder your academic success, I may send an early warning message to you and your study tutor. 課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。

(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
